content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_7_lvl2-template_search-3) to the molecule (the target molecule). The template info: mapped_rxn and template_id 827842. The mapped_rxn is:

'CC(C)(C)[NH2:1].[O:4]=[S:2](=[O:3])(Cl)[CH2:5][C:6]([F:7])([F:8])[F:9].C1CCOC1>>[NH2:1][S:2](=[O:3])(=[O:4])[CH2:5][C:6]([F:7])([F:8])[F:9]'

So forward reaction: reactants: CC(C)(C)[NH2:1] (tert-butyl amine?), plus [O:4]=[S:2](=[O:3])(Cl)[CH2:5][C:6]([F:7])([F:8])[F:9] (some sulfonyl chloride with a CH2 attached to a CF3 group?), plus C1CCOC1 (tetrahydrofuran?) Actually C1CCOC1 is tetrahydrofuran (THF). The product: [NH2:1][S:2](=[O:3])(=[O:4])[CH2:5][C:6]([F:7])([F:8])[F:9] (sulfonamide). So the template is sulfonamide formation: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide, with maybe a solvent (THF) as third reactant (maybe not needed). The template likely expects three reactants: amine, sulfonyl chloride, and maybe a solvent (C1CCOC1). In retrosynthesis, we apply template to product to get precursors: the amine (tert-butyl amine) and sulfonyl chloride (the sulfonyl chloride). Possibly also the solvent is not considered a precursor. The tool apply_template expects a target SMILES and template_id. We need the target molecule SMILES. The target is the product: [NH2:1][S:2](=[O:3])(=[O:4])[CH2:5][C:6]([F:7])([F:8])[F:9] . Remove atom mapping: NH2-S(=O)(=O)-CH2-C(F)(F)F . So SMILES: N S(=O)(=O)CH2C(F)(F)F? Actually the amine is attached to S: N-S(=O)(=O)-CH2-C(F)(F)F . The amine is primary (NH2). So SMILES: NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F? Wait CH2 attached to C(F)(F)F is CF3-CH2? Actually CH2 attached to C(F)(F)F is CH2-C(F)(F)F (i.e., -CH2-CF3). So product SMILES: NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F . But need correct: NS(=O)(=O)CH2C(F)(F)F . That's NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F . So target SMILES: NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F . Also there is a tert-butyl group? Wait the amine is CC(C)(C)[NH2] which is t-butyl amine (tert-butyl). In product, the amine is attached to S, but the t-butyl group is part of the amine? Actually the amine is CC(C)(C)NH2 (tert-butyl amine). So product includes that t-butyl group attached to N: (CH3)3C-NH-SO2-CH2-CF3. So product SMILES: CC(C)(C)N S(=O)(=O)CH2C(F)(F)F . So full SMILES: CC(C)(C)NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F . Yes.

Thus target SMILES: CC(C)(C)NS(=O)(=O)CC(F)(F)F .

Now we need to apply template_id 827842 to this target. Use apply_template tool.
